name: VED-Master
verdict: Russian international-payments company (AO «ВЭД-Мастер»), registry-listed as owned by an individual, Kirill Sumenko. No state in the chain and no human-rights finding found.
note: Official partner of FC Rodina Moscow for season 2026/27 (club announcement 30 Jul 2026); the sponsor's own announcement of 27 Jul 2026 says its logo appears on the first team's match kit. Vedomosti (19 Aug 2026, sponsored feature) reported the same deal. The club's partner widget spells the brand «ВЭДмастер».
